## Preferred framing

- Use "Product Builder" as the primary role label.
- Piotr implements and ships software himself, using AI coding agents inside his engineering workflow. He works directly in the codebase and owns the product decisions, system boundaries, review, integration, and outcome.
- Treat AI agents as the implementation method, not the professional identity.
